task_instance: Run the preflight readiness check for cli-exercise on a trivial target CLI (e.g. `echo`): build the Go helper per the offline-first instructions in references/prerequisites.md, then run `<helper> --skill-root <package-root> preflight check --output <workspace>/preflight.json` to produce a readiness receipt.
blocker_detail: The preflight skill's core deliverable is entirely dependent on artifacts that are not present in the bundle: it instructs to 'follow the offline-first Go build instructions in [the prerequisite reference](../../references/prerequisites.md)' and then invoke '<helper> --skill-root <package-root> preflight check'. Neither references/prerequisites.md, references/runtime-interface.md, nor any Go helper source/internal/ package tree exist anywhere under the cli-exercise skill family (cli__cli__cli-exercise, -preflight, -exact, -explore, -run, -evidence each contain only SKILL.md + LICENSE, no code or reference docs). There is no helper to build and no build instructions to follow, so the check command referenced by the skill cannot be constructed or run at all -- this is a documentation/routing fragment for a package that was never bundled, not a runnable tool. Separately, even the underlying capability surface the preflight would probe is incomplete in this runtime: ffmpeg/ffprobe (required for MP4 chapter intermediates, explicitly called out as needed even for single-case sessions) is not installed, though Go 1.24.7 and Node 22.22 are present.
evidence: Inspected the full cli-exercise skill family tree with `find /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources/cli__cli__cli-exercise*` -- each of cli__cli__cli-exercise, -evidence, -exact, -explore, -preflight, -run contains only SKILL.md and LICENSE. Searched the whole repo with `find ... -iname prerequisites.md -o -iname runtime-interface.md` -> no results. The entry SKILL.md (cli__cli__cli-exercise/SKILL.md) itself links to references/prerequisites.md, references/runtime-interface.md, references/controllers.md, internal/*, tests/skill-evaluations.json -- none of which exist on disk, confirming the referenced package is incomplete/not bundled, not just hard to find. Checked baseline tool availability: `go version` -> go1.24.7 linux/amd64 (present), `node --version` -> v22.22.2 (present), `ffmpeg -version` -> command not found (absent). Since the skill's stated first step ('first follow the offline-first Go build instructions in the prerequisite reference... Build the helper once') cannot be performed (no instructions, no source), the check command and its output preflight.json could not be produced or verified.
